RelationSuggestion.description: How the candidate relates to an existing similar item, assessed during triage independently of the novel-or-duplicate decision.

SimilarItemClassification.description: An independent assessment of one existing claim's relationship to the candidate.

item.description: The existing claim being assessed, referenced by its context index.

justification.description: Why this assessment was chosen, grounded in the content of both claims.

suggested_relation.description: How the candidate relates to the existing claim.

anyOf.description: The candidate records knowledge not already captured by an existing claim. Default to this when the candidate adds any new context, or when uncertain.
The candidate restates an existing claim, adding no meaningful new information. A candidate that contradicts an existing claim is never a duplicate.

matched_item.description: The existing claim this candidate duplicates, referenced by its context index.

TriageDecision.description: Whether the candidate records new knowledge or duplicates an existing claim.

TriageItemReference.description: A reference to one of the provided similar items by its context index.

description: The triage classification for a single candidate. Contains the novel/duplicate decision and independent per-claim relationship assessments.

outcome.description: Whether the candidate is novel or duplicates an existing claim.

similar_item_decisions.description: One assessment per provided similar claim, each made independently of the novel/duplicate outcome.

title: TriageClassification
